issues.description: The UML in the problem statement indicates messageOnFeed() is public (UML shows '+ messageOnFeed(): String'), but the reference solution declares messageOnFeed() as protected in Animal.java. This visibility mismatch could confuse students about the intended access level for the abstract method and how Farm should call it (Farm relies on package/protected access in the solution).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent: either change Animal.messageOnFeed() in the solution to public to match the UML/problem statement, or update the UML/problem statement to indicate a protected method. Ensure the documentation clearly states the intended visibility so students implement the method accordingly.
